features.name: Sign In
features.description: Authenticate with username and password to access the app.

scenarios.name: Successful sign-in with valid credentials
scenarios.expected_outcome: User is authenticated and redirected to the transaction feed at /

scenarios.name: Failed sign-in with invalid credentials
preconditions: Credentials entered do not match any account
scenarios.expected_outcome: Error alert [data-test=signin-error] is displayed; user remains on /signin

steps.transition: auto: dismiss error alert; user edits form

scenarios.name: Redirected to sign-in when accessing a protected route without authentication
preconditions: User navigates directly to any protected route
scenarios.expected_outcome: React Router catch-all redirects user to /signin; after signing in they can proceed

steps.transition: auto: redirect on unauthenticated access to any protected route

features.name: Sign Up
features.description: Register a new account with first name, last name, username, and password.

scenarios.name: Register a new account successfully
preconditions: User does not have an existing account
Chosen username is not already taken
scenarios.expected_outcome: Account is created and user is redirected to /signin to log in

steps.transition: link "Don't have an account? Sign Up" [data-test=signup]

steps.action: Click 'Have an account? Sign In' link [href=/signin]

features.name: Sign Out
features.description: End the authenticated session and return to /signin.

scenarios.name: Sign out from any authenticated page
preconditions: User is on a page that exposes the Logout button in the side navigation
scenarios.expected_outcome: Session is terminated and user is redirected to /signin

features.name: Browse Transaction Feed
features.description: View transactions in three filtered tabs: Everyone (public), Friends, and Mine.

scenarios.name: View all public transactions (Everyone tab)
preconditions: At least one public transaction exists
scenarios.expected_outcome: Transaction feed at / or /public shows all public transactions

scenarios.name: View transactions with contacts (Friends tab)
preconditions: User has contacts with shared transactions
scenarios.expected_outcome: Transaction feed at /contacts shows only transactions involving the user's contacts

scenarios.name: View own transactions (Mine tab)
preconditions: User has at least one transaction as sender or receiver
scenarios.expected_outcome: Transaction feed at /personal shows only the current user's transactions

scenarios.name: Transaction feed shows empty state with create prompt
preconditions: No transactions exist for the selected feed tab
scenarios.expected_outcome: Empty list illustration is shown with an inline 'Create A Transaction' button on public and contacts feeds

steps.transition: auto: conditional render when transaction list has no results

features.name: Filter Transactions
features.description: Narrow the transaction feed by date range or amount range using popover/drawer controls.

scenarios.name: Apply a date range filter to the transaction feed
preconditions: User is on a transaction feed page (/, /contacts, or /personal)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Feed is filtered to show only transactions within the selected date range; chip label updates

steps.transition: click outside popover or backdrop close

scenarios.name: Apply an amount range filter to the transaction feed
preconditions: User is on a transaction feed page (/, /contacts, or /personal)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Feed is filtered to show only transactions within the selected amount range; chip label updates

steps.transition: click outside popover or backdrop close
click outside popover or backdrop close

scenarios.name: Like a transaction
preconditions: User is on a transaction detail page
User has not already liked the transaction
scenarios.expected_outcome: Like count increments; like button becomes disabled for the current user

scenarios.name: Add a comment to a transaction
preconditions: User is on a transaction detail page
scenarios.expected_outcome: Comment appears in the comment thread below the transaction detail

features.name: Respond to a Payment Request
features.description: Accept or reject an incoming pending payment request as the receiver.

scenarios.name: Accept a pending payment request
preconditions: Current user is the receiver of the transaction
scenarios.expected_outcome: Request is accepted; transaction status updates to charged; Accept/Reject buttons disappear

steps.transition: auto: conditional render when receiverIsCurrentUser && status=pending

scenarios.name: Reject a pending payment request
preconditions: Current user is the receiver of the transaction
scenarios.expected_outcome: Request is rejected; transaction status updates; Accept/Reject buttons disappear

steps.transition: auto: conditional render when receiverIsCurrentUser && status=pending

features.name: Create a Transaction
features.description: Send a payment or request money from another user via a 3-step stepper flow.

scenarios.name: Pay another user
preconditions: User has a linked bank account
Recipient user exists in the system
scenarios.expected_outcome: Payment transaction is created; Step 3 shows confirmation with receiver avatar, 'paid' label, amount, and description

scenarios.name: Request money from another user
preconditions: Recipient user exists in the system
scenarios.expected_outcome: Request transaction is created with 'pending' status; Step 3 shows confirmation with 'requested' label

scenarios.name: Create another transaction immediately after completing one
preconditions: User has just completed creating a transaction (on Step 3 confirmation)
scenarios.expected_outcome: XState machine resets to step 1; user can select a new recipient and start a fresh transaction

features.name: Edit User Profile
features.description: Update first name, last name, email, phone number, and privacy level in user settings.

scenarios.name: Save updated profile information
scenarios.expected_outcome: Profile is saved in place; auth machine UPDATE event refreshes the user context; page remains at /user/settings

features.name: View and Dismiss Notifications
features.description: Read and mark-as-read notifications for comments, likes, and payment events.

scenarios.name: Read and dismiss one or more notifications
preconditions: User has at least one unread notification
scenarios.expected_outcome: Notification is marked as read and removed from the unread list

scenarios.name: Notifications page shows empty state
scenarios.expected_outcome: EmptyList component is rendered on the notifications page; no action items are shown

steps.transition: auto: conditional render when notifications results is empty

features.name: Manage Bank Accounts
features.description: View, add, and delete linked bank accounts from the bank accounts list page.

scenarios.name: View list of linked bank accounts
preconditions: User has at least one linked bank account
scenarios.expected_outcome: List of bank accounts is displayed, each with a delete button

scenarios.name: Add a new bank account
scenarios.expected_outcome: Bank account is saved with valid name (≥5 chars), 9-digit routing number, and account number; redirected back to /bankaccounts

scenarios.name: Delete a linked bank account
preconditions: User has at least one linked bank account
scenarios.expected_outcome: Bank account is removed from the list. NOTE: No graph edge exists for the delete action — transition is in-place.

scenarios.name: Bank accounts page shows empty state
preconditions: User has no linked bank accounts
scenarios.expected_outcome: EmptyList component renders with a 'Create' button as the only call to action

steps.transition: auto: conditional render when bankaccounts results is empty

features.name: First-Time Onboarding
features.description: Guide new users through a 3-step modal: welcome → create bank account → finished.

scenarios.name: Complete the full onboarding flow and create a bank account
preconditions: User is authenticated for the first time
User has no linked bank accounts
Onboarding modal is triggered automatically on login
scenarios.expected_outcome: Bank account is created; onboarding modal is dismissed; user lands on transaction feed

scenarios.name: Log out while the onboarding modal is open
preconditions: Onboarding modal is currently displayed (any step)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Session ends; user is redirected to /signin; onboarding modal is closed

features.name: Navigate the Application
features.description: Use the collapsible side navigation drawer to move between main sections of the app.

scenarios.name: Open the side nav and navigate to a section
preconditions: Side navigation is in collapsed or icon-only state
scenarios.expected_outcome: Side nav expands showing user avatar, full name, @username, and balance; clicking a nav item navigates to the target section

scenarios.name: Collapse the side nav to icon-only mode
preconditions: Side navigation is currently expanded (desktop viewport)
scenarios.expected_outcome: Nav drawer collapses to icon-width; labels are hidden; toggle button is still visible
